diagnoses.label: missing completion-event predicate for keyed lifecycle gating
diagnoses.observable_evidence: In senior-data-engineer/SKILL.md under “Semantic Contract Gate for Keyed Event Aggregations”, it lists only “1. Contributing-event predicate …” and then has multiple blank lines; there is no explicit completion-event predicate definition, despite the location hint calling out “完成事件判定的规定”.
diagnoses.mechanism_anchor: Semantic Contract Gate for Keyed Event Aggregations
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Workflows that combine activity events with lifecycle/completion events to decide when an aggregate is eligible to emit (e.g., job finished, session ended).
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Purely time-windowed aggregations that do not require a separate lifecycle/completion signal (e.g., fixed tumbling windows with unconditional emission).
diagnoses.target_section: Workflow 2: Build Real-Time Streaming Pipeline → Semantic Contract Gate for Keyed Event Aggregations
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Add an explicit second predicate defining what constitutes the completion/lifecycle event (and how to treat missing/late completion) distinct from contributing events, so downstream implementations can correctly gate emission.

diagnoses.label: missing output-eligibility rule for emitting results
diagnoses.observable_evidence: The same “Semantic Contract Gate…” section says “preserve three separate predicates” but only enumerates #1 and then jumps to validation bullets; there is no stated rule for “结果输出资格的规定” (output eligibility) such as when to emit, what keys qualify, and how to avoid extra keys.
diagnoses.mechanism_anchor: Semantic Contract Gate for Keyed Event Aggregations
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Any keyed aggregation where output should be emitted only when eligibility conditions are met (e.g., after completion event, after inactivity gap, after watermark/allowed lateness).
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Debug/monitoring sinks that intentionally emit intermediate/partial aggregates continuously.
diagnoses.target_section: Workflow 2: Build Real-Time Streaming Pipeline → Semantic Contract Gate for Keyed Event Aggregations
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Add an explicit third predicate defining output eligibility (emit condition, suppression of partials, handling of late events/watermarks, and key-set expectations) and tie it to the existing positive/negative fixture validation guidance.

overlay.primary_anchor: Semantic Contract Gate for Keyed Event Aggregations
overlay.composition_issue: Because completion-event detection and output-eligibility gating are absent, the remaining guidance (“contributing-event predicate” + fixture checks) is miscomposed: implementers can count the right events but still emit too early/late or emit extra keys, and the validation bullets lack concrete predicates to validate against.
preservation_constraints: Preserve existing Workflow 2 structure and the existing validation bullet list (hand-checkable fixtures) while adding the missing predicates.
Do not alter unrelated sections (other workflows, tool docs, Kafka/Flink templates) that are not part of the Semantic Contract Gate guidance.

package_assessment.rationale: The defect is localized to documentation-level workflow guidance (missing predicates) in an existing file/section; adding the missing semantic rules is feasible without changing external dependencies or unrelated code.
